### The Backfire of the Enemy's Plotting is the Lord's Plotting
Author: The Gospel Coalition
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/the-backfire-of-the-enemys-plotting-is-the-lords-plotting/
Passage: Esther 7:10
Points:
- Haman is destroyed by the very instrument of execution he built for Mordecai.
- What the adversary designed for evil, God sovereignly turns around for good.
- This dramatic reversal reflects the earliest gospel promise regarding the serpent's defeat.
- The enemy's backfiring plot foreshadows the cross, where Satan's apparent victory became his destruction.
- Just as the Persian king's anger subsided, the wrath of the true King is abated at Calvary.
